headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs SPY YTD
summary: As of September 16, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming SPY with an average return of 23.66% compared to SPY's 12.14%. This results in an average alpha of 11.53%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved a remarkable return of 49.14%, significantly contributing to the overall outperformance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 6.91%, highlighting the variability within the set. This outperformance is particularly relevant during periods of market stress, as it suggests resilience against broader market fluctuations. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
